text:
Evelyn Park: Hi team! Im Evelyn, joining as a Product Designer. First day vibe  excited to meet everyone. Quick Qs: who do I ping for MDM/laptop tracking? Also want to check badge pickup & whether theres a plant-drop option. Oh and fun-fact: I used to lead a college a cappella group.
Jared Lin: welcome Evelyn!! Im Jared on IT. Laptop shipped yesterday, tracking: FEDEX 1234. If its not there by noon ping me and Ill escalate. For MDM enroll, open the self-service portal and choose "Company Mac". If you hit issues paste the error here.
Sofia Morales: hey Evelyn  Im Sofia, design lead. So happy youre here. Badge pickup is at reception after 10:30 — Facilities leaves a welcome envelope. Plant: yes we include a small pothos unless you prefer something else.
Evelyn Park: thanks! prefer pothos  and Ill try enrolment now. One more: who handles Figma org invites & shared libraries?
Ben Ortega: hi Evelyn  Ben from product. Ill invite you to the Figma teams after youre in the SSO. If you dont get it by EOD DM me. Also lunchtime intro at 12 in the cafe if you want to join.
Evelyn Park: joining lunch  see you there. enrollment error when running the MDM installer: "Profile installation failed: signed by unknown developer". Anyone seen that?
Jared Lin: yep thats a common Gatekeeper prompt. Run:
```
sudo spctl --master-disable
```
then reinstall the MDM. If youd rather not change Gatekeeper, DM me and Ill remote in.
Evelyn Park: pasting my ssh key so infra can pre-authorize repos (happy to DM instead if prefer):
```
ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIFakeExampleKeyForEvelyn evelyn@home
```
Sofia Morales: fun fact reply: two truths & a lie? Ill guess: you toured with the a cappella group (true), you once opened for a pro band (maybe), you hate sushi (lie?).
Evelyn Park: reveal: toured (true), opened for pro band (lie  just a local fair), hate sushi (false  I love sushi).
OnboarderBot: Welcome Evelyn Park! Account provisioning started. IT ticket IT-4999 opened for device tracking. New-hire checklist: Slack + email OK, benefits invite pending. 1:1 with manager scheduled at 3141660000.
Ben Ortega: Quick note  if you want a standing desk converter reply "desk: standing" and well add it.
Evelyn Park: desk: standing  please. Also thanks everyone  Ill DM Jared if Gatekeeper gets weird. See you at lunch :bento:
